en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a large outdoor café or beer garden filled with many people seated at small round tables under tall trees. Most patrons wear late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century European clothing, including bowler hats and long dresses. The café building with large windows and signage runs along the back, while a tree‑lined open space with crowds of diners extends across the scene.
